senses.gloss: מֵירֵס (denom. of מֶרֶס fr. רסס) to crush; to rub; to stir.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Esth. R. to I, 14</cite> (play on <cite ref="M02724"><he>מֶרֶס</he></cite> <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">ib.</cite>) <he>שהיה מְמָרֵס את העופות</he> he prepared the hash of birds; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">ib.</cite> (play on <cite ref="M02727"><he>מרסנא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">ib.</cite>) <he>שהיה ממרס את הסלתות</he> he stirred the flour (making dough).

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מי ממ׳ לפניך את הדם</he> (not <he>העופות</he>, v. infra) who will stir before thee the blood (of the sacrifices)?; <he>מי ממ׳ … הסלתות</he> who will stir the flour (for the meal offerings)? <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Ib.</cite> (play on <he>מ̇ר̇ס̇ מ̇ר̇ס̇נא ממ̇ו כ̇ן</he>, <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">ib.</cite>) <he>ממ̇ר̇ס̇ אני מ̇סר̇ס̇ וממ̇ע̇ך וכ׳</he> I will crush, chop and dissolve their lives &c.; <cite ref="Megillah 12b:10">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>כלום מֵ֗ירְ֗ס֗וּ בדם לפניך</he> did they ever stir the blood (of sacrifices) before thee? <he>כלום מ̇ירס̇ו לפניך במנ̇חות</he> did they ever stir the flour for the meal offerings &c.?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1051:1">Yalk. Esth. 1051</cite> <he>מֵרְסוּ</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:3">Yoma IV, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:3">V, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:10">Shebi. II, 10</cite> <he>מְמָרְסִין באורז וכ׳</he> you may, in the Sabbatical year, stir (mix) the ground of a rice field with water (so as to make it dough-like).
